name: Staking and Incentive Misalignment
definition: What an agent risks diverges from what the system needs it to care about.
trigger_conditions: The stake is smaller than the value at issue in a single decision
Loss from a bad outcome falls on a party other than the decider
Stake is denominated in something the agent can reacquire faster than it can be slashed

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: actors capture upside of excessive risk without bearing all of its cost

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F005 Staking and Incentive Misalignment. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F005
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
